title: docs: scaffold examples pin exact; verify README names the scheduled-work switch
body:
Part of #25510

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

These are two docs fixes the devx lane owed, with no code change.

## What changed

- **`content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx`**
  - The plugin `package.json` example now pins `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/cli` to exact `18.0.0`. Before, it showed `^17.0.0`.
  - The paragraph under it now says the scaffolders pin each `@objectstack/*` dependency exactly to the generating CLI's version (`getCliVersion()`), never as a caret range. That is what PR #25539 made them write.
- **`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, step 2:** a project scaffolded since 18.1.0 is exact-pinned. A project on a caret range (`^18.0.0`, what older scaffolds wrote) still moves at the lockfile step.
- **`packages/verify/README.md`:** after the `flows.run(…, { system: true })` passage, the README now says three things:
  - that call works with scheduled work off;
  - a local stack arms time-triggered flows on their own cadence only with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true`;
  - package-authored scheduled work is off by default in every posture.
  The #25442 evaluation read "disabled by deployment policy" on a local verify stack with the variable unset. Ruling D on that card asked for this sentence to ride the next docs PR.
- **`.changeset/25442-verify-readme-scheduled-work.md`:** a patch for `@objectstack/verify`, because `README.md` ships in its tarball (`files`).

Sources were read on `main` at the time of writing:
- `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:37` (`getCliVersion`) and `:57` (`pkgVersion`);
- `packages/cli/src/commands/create.ts:166` (`objectstackDependencySpec`);
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx:103`.

## Out of scope

The rest of #25510 is the template baseline and `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs`. That work is in its own card thread, whose PR carries `Fixes #25510`. This PR only says `Part of`, so the Duplicate Fix Guard is not engaged.

## Local verification

Run on `origin/main` `baae6ed14e` plus this commit:
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 88 derived families accounted for, 79 run (all exit 0), 9 NOT MEASURED.
- The 9 NOT MEASURED families need build artifacts this worktree does not have (`json-schema`, `dist`):
  - `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`;
  - the spec `check:docs` and `check:skill-examples`;
  - the lint `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture`.
  None of them reads the three edited files. CI runs them.
- The docs families ran and passed: `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:published-readme-links`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check-doc-frontmatter` and `check-issue-citations`.
